# YSV Hair Salon & Spa

> YSV Hair Salon & Spa is a boutique full-service hair salon and spa in the Edgewater neighborhood of Miami, Florida, at 1900 N Bayshore Dr, Suite 206 (Quantum on the Bay), Miami, FL 33132. Founded in 2011 by Yair Vaknin, it offers balayage, highlights, hair extensions, keratin, hair Botox, cuts and blowouts, men's grooming, facials, nails, brows and make-up. Valet parking is free for every visit.

## Key facts

- Name: YSV Hair Salon & Spa (also "YSV Salon")
- Address: 1900 N Bayshore Dr, Suite 206, Quantum on the Bay, Miami, FL 33132 (Edgewater, near the Venetian Causeway)
- Phone: (786) 574-9850 · second line (786) 715-5105
- Email: contact@ysvhairsalon.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. Closed Sunday.
- Parking: complimentary valet
- Languages: English and Spanish
- Founder: Yair Vaknin. YSV opened on Lincoln Road, South Beach in 2011, and in Edgewater in 2014.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ysv_salon_spa/
- Google Business Profile: https://share.google/eKOMB9QD16n1FtKdh
- Neighborhoods served: Edgewater, Wynwood, Midtown, Design District, Downtown Miami, Brickell, Arts & Entertainment District, Miami Beach, Venetian Islands

## Starting prices

- Women's haircut: $85 and up · cut and blow-dry: $119 (short) / $149 (long) and up
- Blow-dry and shampoo: $65 and up · updo: $119 and up
- Balayage: $249 and up · full highlights: $249 and up · partial highlights: $149 and up
- All-over color: $99 and up · root color: $95 and up · gloss: $85 and up
- Keratin: $349 and up (men $100 and up) · hair Botox: $299 and up · Olaplex: $50 and up
- Hair extensions (tape-in and keratin): by consultation
- Men's haircut: $45 and up · beard: $15 · kids' haircut: $40
- Facials: $145 to $215 · microneedling: $199 and up
- Gel manicure: $55 · classic pedicure: $55
- Special: buy 4, get 1 free on women's color (from the first visit), blow-dries, men's cuts and treatments

Final prices are confirmed by the stylist at a consultation.

## Hair services

- [Services and full price list](https://ysvhairsalon.com/services/): every hair, nail and spa service with starting prices
- [Balayage & highlights](https://ysvhairsalon.com/balayage-highlights-miami/): balayage, foils, ombré, color correction, gloss
- [Hair extensions](https://ysvhairsalon.com/hair-extensions-miami/): Hairtalk tape-in and keratin extensions, color matched
- [Keratin treatment](https://ysvhairsalon.com/keratin-treatment-miami/): smoothing and frizz control for Miami humidity
- [Hair Botox](https://ysvhairsalon.com/hair-botox-miami/): deep conditioning repair for dry, damaged or color-treated hair
- [Cuts & blowouts](https://ysvhairsalon.com/haircuts-blowouts-miami/): women's, men's and kids' cuts, blowouts and updos

## Spa services

- [Spa](https://ysvhairsalon.com/spa/): facials, body treatments, massage, nails and make-up
- [Facials](https://ysvhairsalon.com/hydrafacial-miami/): HydraGlow, custom, acne and men's facials, microneedling
- [Scalp micropigmentation](https://ysvhairsalon.com/scalp-micropigmentation/): SMP for thinning hair, hair loss and scars
- [Brows, lashes & make-up](https://ysvhairsalon.com/eyebrow-shaping-miami/): brow shaping, lashes, event make-up
- [Manicure & pedicure](https://ysvhairsalon.com/manicure-pedicure-edgewater/): gel, Russian, hard gel and poly gel nails
